questions.question: Paul wrote that all things were created in God's Son. Which of these did he say were included?
Paul wrote that God's Son is the firstborn from among the dead. What is the reason for this?

answers.text: So He has first place in all things
So the church grows in number
So the prophets are proven true

questions.question: Paul wrote that God reconciles all things to Himself through His Son. How was peace made?

answers.text: Through the blood of His cross
Through the law given at Sinai
